known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中全部水下速度技能检查并把对应 1.05/1.10 倍率路径改为 2.0；不同水下动作可能仍有独立倍率。对照时只启用本项并关闭 #65（#65 会把通用技能查询强制为真），保持相同 FPS 设置与动作，对同一路线计时，不要只凭目测。 / English: Forces all JP-v96 underwater-speed skill checks and changes the corresponding 1.05/1.10 multiplier paths to 2.0; some underwater actions may use separate multipliers. For an isolated comparison, enable only this pack and disable #65 (which forces the generic skill query true), keep the same FPS setting and action, and time the same underwater route instead of relying on visual judgment alone.

summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #13“水下速度 2 倍”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #13 "Underwater Speed ×2" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
